property_summary: For any caller A and any address U, getBalance(U) must return the stored userBalance[U]; the mutant returning userBalance[msg.sender] violates this when caller != U and balances differ (i.e., there exists A,U,amounts where userBalance[A] != userBalance[U]).
change_summary: Change the returned mapping key from the provided address to msg.sender so getBalance returns the caller's balance regardless of the argument.
